eligible_nationalities: All countries outside the EU/EEA and Switzerland (tuition-fee-paying applicants)

financial_coverage.tuition_coverage: Full tuition fee for an international master's programme

stipend.notes: No living costs; you must show funds for living costs for the Swedish residence permit

application_fee.notes: SEK 900 University Admissions in Sweden application fee for the programme application (cannot be waived); no fee for the scholarship application itself

eligibility_criteria.min_gpa: Strong academic record; must meet programme admission requirements

required_documents.name: Programme application on universityadmissions.se with Uppsala as first priority
required_documents.detail: Programme application 16 Oct 2026 to 15 Jan 2027; documents by 1 Feb 2027

required_documents.name: Motivation letter
required_documents.detail: Maximum 350 words, in the scholarship form

preparation_alerts: Apply to the programme first, with Uppsala as your first priority, by 15 Jan 2027
Only about 2% of applicants get a scholarship

selection_criteria.pass_rule: Merit-based; financial need is not considered

source_urls.title: Uppsala University: master's scholarships
source_urls.used_for: Scholarship window 16 Jan to 1 Feb 2027, coverage, eligibility, motivation letter, 2% success rate

verification_status.verification_notes: Facts from official uu.se pages as summarised in search results (pages not opened directly). The lead called these 'IPK scholarships'; no scheme by that name was found; this is Uppsala's Global Scholarship. A separate King Carl XVI Gustaf scholarship (SEK 40,000/yr from autumn 2027) is for students already enrolled.
